comment: Triage of every PARTIAL register row on 2026-10-18 by seventeen read-only graders (one per domain batch, code and tests read, nothing run), clustered into implementation lanes by crate and file so parallel sessions edit disjoint code. A lane closes a row only when the behaviour runs on a default path or a committed deployment and a mutated test proves it; a row a lane finds not closable gets its gap corrected instead. Categories other than code_small/test_only are listed for later waves: owner_switch rows wait on a committed deployment value, deploy_dependent rows on a dev apply or scrape, design_adr rows on a decision record, real_missing_large rows on a build larger than one lane.

design_adr.closure: Write the ADR deciding which research family is built (and any dependency) before adding a FamilyDeclaration in qip-quantum/src/foundry.rs with its classical baseline and a QuantumExperiment record; test solvers.rs asserts the record and the baseline.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Lessons propagate globally; the artifact includes ReflexDelta — the cell keeps RegionalEpisodes locally (cell.rs:1381) but CellReport (central/plane.rs:318) carries no episodes, ReflexDelta exists only as a doc mention (regional_episode.rs:11), and adding episodes to the cell-to-centre report is an ADR 0100 wire-contract change
design_adr.closure: Amend ADR 0100 to carry RegionalEpisode summaries on the cell report, then add the field to CellReport and the edge envelope, a ReflexDelta contract, and a qip-kernel/tests/central.rs test that an ingested report's episodes reach learn_from_cells.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Across a shadow environment — the campaign's Shadow stage (executor.rs:346) is the second half of post-start paper fills and Simulated is a bootstrap of historical fills; the four-stage record is produced and tested (expansion_rows.rs:730) but what 'shadow' means on a paper-only platform is undecided
design_adr.closure: Write an ADR defining the shadow environment for a paper-only platform (candidate run alongside the live paper book without acting) and, if distinct, add that stage source in executor.rs::run_fill_bias_campaign with a loop.rs test; otherwise accept the current definition in the register.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Evidence and rollback requirements scale with authority — qip-agency autonomy.rs::widen (autonomy.rs:87) refuses anything above narrow-reversible with 'broader agency needs an ADR', so no graded schedule can exist without one
design_adr.closure: Write the ADR defining authority levels and the evidence/rollback strength each requires, then encode the schedule in qip-agency/src/autonomy.rs::widen with tests/agency.rs asserting each level refuses the lesser evidence.

design_adr.unmet_clause: a phase's exit capability is demonstrated before the next phase's capabilities are enabled
design_adr.closure: The tree deliberately carries every phase at once with no feature gating; gating later-phase features on a recorded exit check is a product/architecture decision needing an ADR (phase register in docs/architecture plus a qip-acceptance test reading it), not a code fix.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Spanner owns financial truth; GCS owns retained archives; Bigtable owns hot derived features
design_adr.closure: qip-storage names Bigtable only as a provider variant (provider.rs:32) with no client, and the ledger truth is qip-ledgerd's DurableStore; a Spanner ledger writer, GCS archive and Bigtable feature store are storage-client additions that ADR 0109 routes through their own ADR, with enable_spanner/enable_bigtable/enable_cloud_storage flipped afterwards; the single-owner architecture test can follow in qip-acceptance/tests/architecture.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: independently scalable services (each cognitive service a separately deployable binary)
design_adr.closure: Cognitive services are libraries composed in-process by qip-kernel into three Cloud Run binaries; splitting them is the architecture decision the row itself names (ADR 0024 catalogue), so an ADR precedes any new binary and catalogue.tf entry.

design_adr.unmet_clause: managed sessions/memory may use Agent Engine and long-lived deterministic agents run elsewhere (a second runtime)
design_adr.closure: Adding a runtime field to qip-agents/src/manifest.rs::AgentManifest and an Agent Engine adapter changes a shared contract and admits an external managed runtime, both ADR-first under the repo's rules.

design_adr.unmet_clause: concurrent world models ... consulted in the cycle (decisions still read the single WorldModel)
design_adr.closure: qip-kernel/src/federation_stage.rs:14-19 states the federation is advisory by design and that an arbitrated probability moving a size is a control no ADR admits; consuming the FederationReview in REASON/DECIDE needs an ADR before platform.rs::stage_reason reads it.

design_adr.unmet_clause: not a single monolithic model (decisions still read the single WorldModel)
design_adr.closure: The five-axis population is built and tested (federation_stage.rs:872); unfed members producing no state is deliberate (:26-30); making decisions consume the federation is the ADR named in federation_stage.rs:14-19, so file it before wiring platform.rs::stage_reason.

design_adr.unmet_clause: served by reflex/microstructure models producing fill probability, queue movement, adverse selection, executable edge
design_adr.closure: Admission refusal is tested for every row (forecast_lattice.rs:81-98); issuing the microsecond row needs a reflex-lane caller, and lane_placement.rs forbids qip-world-model in the node's closure, so a reflex forecast contract crossing that boundary is an ADR before code.

design_adr.unmet_clause: calibrated distributions from microseconds (the microsecond row is never issued)
design_adr.closure: lattice_stage.rs:18-22 refuses the central lane at the microsecond row by design and the reflex node may not link qip-world-model (lane_placement.rs), so a microsecond issuer needs a lane-boundary ADR (a reflex-side forecast contract in qip-contracts) before any code.

design_adr.unmet_clause: write normalised entities/edges into Spanner Graph
design_adr.closure: qip-storage has no Spanner client beyond the provider catalogue and enable_spanner=false everywhere; a Spanner Graph writer is a storage-client addition ADR 0109 routes through its own ADR, after which qip-world-model/src/graph.rs::KnowledgeGraph gains a writer sink and architecture.rs:758 keeps edge crates out.

design_adr.unmet_clause: capital sizing contracts on their staleness
design_adr.closure: lattice.rs:32-35 states that an order-path caller of staleness_multiplier 'would be a sizing decision for an ADR' and lattice_stage.rs:34-36 keeps forecasts off thesis/size/order; file that ADR before platform.rs's sizing seam reads lattice::staleness_multiplier.

design_adr.unmet_clause: run as a separate service whose outage only accumulates research backlog
design_adr.closure: Backlog semantics exist (lattice_stage.rs:207,318; now_lattice.rs::with_the_strategic_service_down...); a separate strategic binary or Cloud Run service is the same catalogue decision as ARCH-9012 and needs an ADR before a new app crate and catalogue.tf entry.

design_adr.unmet_clause: every material forecast (thesis beliefs, feature ForecastLattice, demand forecasts do not use the contract)
design_adr.closure: qip_contracts::forecast::Forecast already refuses a missing field; making thesis beliefs, feature.rs::ForecastLattice and capital-fabric demand forecasts carry it changes shared contracts across qip-contracts, qip-kernel and qip-capital-fabric and belongs in an ADR first.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Fabric mirrors lag and catch up when the link returns
design_adr.closure: ADR 0100 §3 refuses a mirror process, so an ADR must admit one before Mirroring (qip-events/src/event_fabric/policy.rs:143) gets a runtime; automatic peer-loss detection could separately derive darkness from MeshSeries.circuit (qip-edge-node/src/mesh.rs:220) into dark.rs with a test in tests/dark.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: critical Fabric topics must have selective cross-region mirrors
design_adr.closure: Mirroring is a policy field only (qip-events/src/event_fabric/policy.rs:143); ADR 0100 §3 refuses a mirror process, so an ADR must admit one before a fabric-mirror can be written and tested.

design_adr.unmet_clause: flow directly between the venue (FIX/WS/native TCP/UDP) and the Reflex node
design_adr.closure: A real venue path is refused by ADR 0003/0021 and FEED_VARIABLE accepts only 'simulated' (apps/qip-edge-node/src/feed.rs:119); admitting a market-data-only native feed needs an ADR before any code.

design_adr.unmet_clause: telemetry ... drained asynchronously from the node to the regional fabric
design_adr.closure: An ADR deciding whether telemetry rides the fabric as a Recorded kind or stays scrape-only under ADR 0024's posture; the policy ack (Recorded::PolicyApplied, tested in decision_loop.rs) already carries the payload whose trained_models slot is the model ack.

design_adr.unmet_clause: forwarded asynchronously ... to learning
design_adr.closure: Learning already takes cell fills through Platform::ingest_cell_report (qip-kernel/src/platform.rs:6062) over the mesh, so a fabric-to-learning forward would be a second source for the same facts; an ADR must choose one before a deepbrain fabric consumer and the node->fabricd->ledgerd acceptance test are written.

design_adr.unmet_clause: mlock and busy polling (no mlockall or busy-poll in qip-edge-node)
design_adr.closure: mlockall/sched busy-poll need a syscall path, i.e. libc on scripts/dependency-allowlist.txt via ADR 0109, before any code in qip-edge-node; isolcpus/huge pages/CPUAffinity are already in startup.sh.tftpl:67-85, :352.

design_adr.unmet_clause: mlockall, tuned IRQ/RPS/XPS, local scratch SSD
design_adr.closure: mlockall needs libc admitted through ADR 0109 first; IRQ/RPS/XPS tuning then lands in startup.sh.tftpl beside :67-85 with a tftest, and scratch SSD needs an lssd shape outside the current allowlist (variables.tf:140-150).

design_adr.unmet_clause: so two active owners never exist (across zones: FileLeaseStore is single-host, standby.rs:44-55)
design_adr.closure: A cross-zone lease store with a real conditional write (object generation precondition or Spanner transaction, ADR 0111/0113) must be decided and admitted before LeaseKeeper can fence across zones; Terraform now passes fencing_lease_path/node_role to both templates (main.tf:486-487, :927-928), so that part of the gap text is stale.

design_adr.unmet_clause: any order pattern constituting wash activity is refused before it leaves the platform (cross-cell/cross-venue)
design_adr.closure: Per-cell netting (cell.rs::net) blocks intra-cell crossing; a pre-trade cross-cell refusal needs a central hop that ADR 0008 (cells decide alone) forbids, so an ADR must choose between instrument sharding per cell and a centre-side detector before code.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Continuous quoting (quotes are priced and sent nowhere)
design_adr.closure: qip-kernel/src/quote_loop.rs:1-20 deliberately has no path to an order and the node ModeGate (apps/qip-edge-node/src/lib.rs:229-238) refuses Quoting until legal/operational support is recorded; placing quotes even on the simulator needs an ADR, after which the other scope items (skew, adverse selection, rate control, spread, portfolio-aware) are already in quoting.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: a quote engine (quoting mode is refused at the node)
design_adr.closure: ModeGate in apps/qip-edge-node/src/lib.rs:229-238 enables only OrderTaking and Routing until legal and operational support is recorded; enabling Quoting and building an edge quote engine on the simulated venue is an ADR decision first (order types, venue selection, leg sequencing and cancel/replace are already tested at pass.rs:1173 and best_venue.rs).

design_adr.unmet_clause: Market-making quotes (placed, even on the simulator)
design_adr.closure: Every component is tested in qip-execution-engine/src/quoting.rs and priced in ACT by quote_loop::review (platform.rs:15869), but quote_loop.rs:13-18 is written so no path leads to an order; routing priced quotes to the simulated broker is a boundary decision that needs an ADR before code.

design_adr.unmet_clause: connect directly to venues (real venues; only the simulated venue is reachable)
design_adr.closure: The node binds its own feed and gateway (pass.rs::run_pass, gateway.rs) with no central hop, tested in tests/pass.rs; a real venue connection is refused by ADR 0003/0021 and stays partial until an ADR changes that posture.

design_adr.unmet_clause: consume Knowledge Catalog / Spanner Graph / BigQuery evidence and publish ... through the Fabric
design_adr.closure: A Spanner Graph / BigQuery read adapter is a storage-client crate and a new cloud surface that ADR 0109 routes through its own ADR (ADR 0113 moves only the ledger to Spanner; enable_spanner is unset); qip-storage provider.rs names the targets with no adapter. Fabric publication of research tasks is R12-AMBIENT-10108's bounded change; the evidence read path needs the ADR first.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Each action surface (communications, posting, outreach, ... product/pricing/config, operational, capital/hedging/liquidity, commerce, market/product creation) is a typed tool
design_adr.closure: Only the internal-outbox drafting tool is registered in production (ambient_intake.rs:305 ToolRegistration); ADR 0114 D8 refuses posting, outreach, pricing and operational surfaces and ADR 0003/0021/0108 refuse capital surfaces, so registering the remaining surfaces is routed through those ADRs, not code.

design_adr.unmet_clause: run surveys/experiments where permitted
design_adr.closure: Surveys and experiments on the outside world are external actions refused by ADR 0114 D8 (owner decision D5, 2026-10-11); only an ADR reopening D8 would admit an Adapter implementation outside tests (engine.rs:187; qip-cli Unwired refuses every call). Lawful data acquisition and internal simulations already exist.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Public/channel adapters use segregated credentials
design_adr.closure: No public channel adapter may exist under ADR 0114 D8 (owner decision D5); the only channel is internal-outbox under its own registered identity (ambient_intake.rs:305) and the conduct gate already blocks non-compliant drafts (qip-agency/tests/conduct_brain.rs); credential segregation for external channels waits on an ADR reopening D8.

design_adr.unmet_clause: no agent identity holds production write/SSH/kubectl grants
design_adr.closure: No principal distinguishes an agent from a person (agent-guard.mjs:30-33 marker detection only); an agent identity model (a dedicated Workload Identity pool for agent sessions with read-only grants) is a contract change across IAM and the agent boundary that needs an ADR amending ADR 0117/0124 before any Terraform.

design_adr.unmet_clause: run in a dedicated project
design_adr.closure: One project per environment is the committed shape and ADR 0113 defers the organisation split to the second region; moving scouts to their own project needs that ADR amended (or a new one) before any Terraform, since the trust-zone subnet (modules/trust-zones/main.tf:141-160) already gives them their own network and egress identity.

design_adr.unmet_clause: works with sandboxed credentials
design_adr.closure: CI acceptance runs are sandboxed (agent-sandbox.yml) but the coder session that writes and pushes receives no per-run credential from this repository and is recognised only by markers (agent-policy.json:4-11); issuing scoped per-run credentials is an identity-model decision needing an ADR amending ADR 0117/0124.

design_adr.unmet_clause: provenance (SBOM/attestation) pushed with the image
design_adr.closure: An ADR must admit a provenance producer (actions/attest-build-provenance pinned by SHA, or gcloud-only SLSA statement) before a deploy.yml step after sign-and-create (:557) attaches it; then gitops.rs test the_pipeline_attaches_slsa_provenance_to_every_pushed_digest.

design_adr.unmet_clause: environment-specific behaviour comes from signed configuration
design_adr.closure: An ADR must choose what signs tfvars/manifests and what verifies them at start-up (in-tree HMAC/trust root vs KMS) before qip-api/fastbrain/deepbrain main.rs verify a configuration signature; then an infrastructure.rs test refuses an unsigned env.

design_adr.unmet_clause: Production workloads are reconciled from Git
design_adr.closure: gitops.rs::prod_is_promoted_by_nobody_until_an_adr_says_otherwise pins the current refusal; only an ADR reopening a prod control plane (ADR 0036/0093) can close the clause, and the paper posture argues against it.

design_adr.unmet_clause: A fuzz job runs on PRs and fails on a crash
design_adr.closure: cargo-fuzz targets need the libfuzzer-sys crate and nightly, so an ADR must admit them to scripts/dependency-allowlist.txt before a ci.yml fuzz job and a pipeline_scripts.rs assertion are added.

design_adr.unmet_clause: a regression rolls back automatically and creates an incident/task
design_adr.closure: Platform::release_decision (platform.rs:9248) has no production caller; expose it on a qip-api route for a Kargo verification step, but automatic rollback on Cloud Run needs an ADR because ADR 0114 refuses Argo Rollouts.

design_adr.unmet_clause: A prod/engineering project must hold ...
design_adr.closure: ADR 0118 and ADR 0113 §4 keep one project per environment until the second region, so a separate engineering project needs an ADR reopening that; the private pool piece is the cloud_build_private_pool_enabled switch.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'capital grants contract automatically' never executes in a shipped binary: Platform::issue_capital is refused because qip-api auth.rs::Principal::presence always returns Unattested (ADR 0065).
design_adr.closure: Write ADR 0121 (attested operator presence), then Principal::presence carries an attestation and routes.rs capital-grant route reaches CentralPlane::issue_narrowed; qip-api/tests asserts an issued grant is narrowed.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'using the hybrid solver router' (no SolverRouter exists in the workspace) and 'unwind plans' (only a feasibility flag and decay days).
design_adr.closure: ADR deciding whether hedge search routes through a solver router under ADR 0006's baseline rule; then hedge_search.rs::search emits an UnwindPlan (staged quantity per day) beside the flag, tested in hedge_search.rs::tests.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'HedgePlan contracts ... to regions over the Rust Fabric' — HedgePlan stays central; no spine frame carries it.
design_adr.closure: ADR adding a HedgePlan frame beside CapitalGrantFrame (qip-mesh spine.rs:95) and the cell's acceptance rule; then qip-edge-node/tests/degraded.rs asserts a cell applies and refuses beyond it.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'first-class autonomous domain with explicit contracts' — Asset Brain has no crate boundary or autonomous loop.
design_adr.closure: ADR naming the asset-brain crate and its typed contracts, then extract from qip-portfolio-engine/qip-lifecycle with contract tests.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'first-class autonomous domain with explicit contracts' — Capital Brain has no crate boundary or autonomous loop.
design_adr.closure: ADR naming the capital-brain boundary over qip-capital/qip-capital-fabric and its contracts, then a contract test suite.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'first-class autonomous domain with explicit contracts' — Risk Brain has no crate boundary or autonomous loop.
design_adr.closure: ADR naming the risk-brain boundary over qip-risk/qip-risk-engine and its contracts, then a contract test suite.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'first-class autonomous domain with explicit contracts' — Treasury Bank has no crate boundary or autonomous loop.
design_adr.closure: ADR naming the treasury boundary over qip-capital treasury and qip-capital-fabric corridors/custody, then a contract test suite.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'first-class autonomous domain with explicit contracts' — Ledger Brain is a binary over qip_contracts::ledger with no brain boundary.
design_adr.closure: ADR naming the ledger-brain contract (postings, balances, obligations) and its loop, then contract tests across qip-ledgerd and qip-contracts.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'first-class autonomous domain with explicit contracts' — Settlement Brain is split between capital-fabric settlement and the edge gate.
design_adr.closure: ADR naming the settlement-brain boundary and contract, then contract tests over qip-capital-fabric settlement.rs and qip-edge settlement.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'constrained by ... drawdown' — the signed CapitalEnvelope carries no peak-to-trough bound distinct from the loss limit.
design_adr.closure: ADR amending the CapitalEnvelope/ExposureBounds contract (qip-contracts capital.rs:435-462) with a drawdown bound; then cell.rs:4876 refuses past it, tested in qip-edge/tests/envelope_exposure.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'market making ... reserved through one reservation fabric' — quoting is not a cell mode, so market-making capital never meets the RegionTable.
design_adr.closure: ADR placing market-making reservations on the cell's RegionTable (reservation.rs:522) or moving quote_loop capital into it; then a reservation.rs test that a quote and an arbitrage leg cannot both reserve the same capital.

design_adr.unmet_clause: 'no alpha/model component can construct, relax or bypass their decisions' holds structurally for qip-capital/qip-risk only; hedge and model-risk live in qip-kernel and rest on a substring scan.
design_adr.closure: ADR extracting survival.rs/confidence.rs/hedge.rs into a crate with no alpha dependency; then survival_independence.rs::no_survival_or_risk_crate_can_reach_an_alpha_crate covers it by closure.

design_adr.unmet_clause: one trace across brain, model, risk, node, venue, ledger and learning loop (the cycle id is not on the reflex or ledger wire and is never joined to the cell's chain_correlation).
design_adr.closure: Carry the decision cycle id on the signed PolicyPayload/order wire (qip-contracts/src/policy.rs, reflex.rs::chain_correlation) and on the ledger outcome so FillBooked and learning records share it; that changes two signed contracts and needs an ADR before an acceptance test in vertical_slice_correlation.rs follows one id through every hop.

design_adr.unmet_clause: A correlation id set at the API appears in the cell's event metadata (the API's lineage ids and the cell's chain_correlation are independent id spaces).
design_adr.closure: Carrying the API-set id into the cell requires a field on the signed PolicyPayload/order wire (qip-contracts reflex.rs::chain_correlation), a contract change the rules route through an ADR; then an acceptance test asserts the id set in routes.rs::observe_fresh reaches the cell's journal.

design_adr.unmet_clause: direct QUIC (the peer link is TCP+mTLS in qip-peer-link, and it runs only when QIP_PEER_MESH_LISTEN and QIP_PEER_MESH_PEERS are set).
design_adr.closure: QUIC needs a new transport crate on the allow-list, so an ADR under ADR 0109 first; the socket exchange itself is already proven by qip-peer-link/tests/peer_mesh.rs::two_nodes_carry_a_cycle_through_token_reserved_fire_fill_and_unwind_over_the_socket, and the env pair is the owner switch for the rest.

design_adr.unmet_clause: direct peer-to-peer QUIC mesh (transport is TCP+mTLS over qip-transport; QUIC needs a crate not on the allow-list).
design_adr.closure: Write the ADR admitting a QUIC crate under ADR 0109 before any transport change in qip-peer-link/src/wire.rs; the bounded-deadline exchange is already proven by qip-peer-link/tests/peer_mesh.rs and the env pair QIP_PEER_MESH_LISTEN/QIP_PEER_MESH_PEERS is the deployment switch.

design_adr.unmet_clause: exists between brains (consumed only by qip-ledgerd as a funding statement; the cell enforces CapitalEnvelope, and liquidity reserve, drawdown stop and ADV share are restated from the envelope rather than set by the issuer)
design_adr.closure: Amend ADR 0123 (or a new ADR) to make CapitalGrant the signed downward authority the cell applies (CapitalGrantFrame bound body change under the schema lock), then have qip_edge::Cell decode and enforce it; test in downward_signed_path.rs that a grant with an issuer-set reserve binds the cell's ledger.

design_adr.unmet_clause: region and auth context carried on the wire (qip-ledgerd consumer.rs:220 stamps a local region and a non-authenticated auth context)
design_adr.closure: Amend ADR 0100/0111 to define the authenticated principal and region fields of FabricEnvelope on the wire (additive under the schema lock), then carry them from FabricEnvelope::open_decoded's producer side and refuse a consumer-fabricated one; test in event_fabric_policy.rs that an envelope without a wire-carried principal is refused.

design_adr.unmet_clause: exists between brains (no producer or consumer; the cross-region mirror it checkpoints is refused under ADR 0099 C8, policy.rs:451-456, and listed open in ADR 0111)
design_adr.closure: Amend ADR 0099 C8 to admit a paper-only cross-region mirror, then emit a MirrorCheckpoint per mirrored partition from the mirror seam and verify its integrity hash at the destination; test that a checkpoint with a stale source offset is refused.

design_adr.unmet_clause: plus venue/custody statements
design_adr.closure: No custodian seam exists in a paper platform; an ADR must name what stands for custody truth (e.g. the simulated broker's holding statement) before qip-ledgerd store.rs gains a statement comparison with a seeded-break test in qip-ledgerd/tests/store.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: flow to ledger, treasury, settlement and inventory
design_adr.closure: Settlement needs the in-settlement subledger ADR (5011: fills post into it, a settled transition is booked by a producer that observes it); inventory's only observer is commerce_research.rs::CommerceResearch::plane_apply under QIP_DEEPBRAIN_BREADTH_PLAN (5018); test: qip-acceptance vertical_slice_ship.rs fill -> settlement -> inventory postings.

design_adr.unmet_clause: carries its settlement state through to settlement
design_adr.closure: ADR for a simulated pending -> settled lifecycle without a live variant: an in-settlement subledger fills post into and a settled transition booked at T+n by a producer that observes it, changing how LedgerStore posts cash on Decision::Filled (qip-contracts ledger.rs:42 Settlement::Simulated only); test qip-ledgerd/tests/store.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: lineage intent -> order -> fill -> settlement -> position/cash impact that can be walked in both directions
design_adr.closure: SourceEvent (qip-contracts/src/ledger.rs) needs an intent id field on a persisted hash-chained record and a settlement record (5011's ADR); then an acceptance walk ledger -> journal -> intent in qip-acceptance/tests/vertical_slice_correlation.rs (mutation: drop order_id from SourceEvent).

design_adr.unmet_clause: custody subledger postings from a production producer
design_adr.closure: No custodian exists in the paper platform; an ADR must name what stands for custody (simulated broker holding statement or none) before a producer can post the custody OperationKind; test qip-ledgerd/tests/store.rs subledger posting plus trial balance.

design_adr.unmet_clause: TLS/domain identity, signed releases where available, known issuer identity
design_adr.closure: Needs a trusted issuer/signing-key registry contract and config surface (qip_transport::trust P-256 verification exists since 56f2c191; fabric.rs:265-267 still cites ADR 0043) before connector/evidence.rs can credit SignatureVerified; test: a verified-issuer claim outranks an unsigned copy in qip-world-model/tests/evidence_fabric.rs.

design_adr.unmet_clause: dispatches parallel candidate computations to CPU/GPU/TPU/QPU — no GPU or TPU backend exists (compute.rs Substrate::Gpu/Tpu always Declined)
design_adr.closure: ADR admitting an accelerator backend (Vertex AI, enable_vertex_ai = false in dev tfvars:285) before adding Gpu/Tpu arms to qip-optimization-engine/src/compute.rs::Substrate dispatch and a parallel fan-out test.

design_adr.unmet_clause: routed across CPU, GPU, TPU and QPU — no router places work on GPU/TPU; ComputeResourceType exists only as a contract
design_adr.closure: ADR for an accelerator backend (enable_vertex_ai) before a hardware router in qip-optimization-engine/src/compute.rs assigns Gpu/Tpu by declared eligibility and records why.

design_adr.unmet_clause: GPU/TPU7x pools — no accelerator arm; benchmark memory already exists (RoutingLearning resumed from journal, compute_routing.rs:194-212)
design_adr.closure: ADR for accelerator pools before Gpu/Tpu substrates in compute.rs; correct register text that benchmark memory is present.

design_adr.unmet_clause: TPU/GPU/QPU use is selected by measured workload fit — no GPU/TPU selection exists; quantum half enforced (model_serving.rs:619-650)
design_adr.closure: ADR for accelerator backend, then fit measurement per Substrate in compute.rs::InformationValue; promotion refusals already tested (serving.rs:713).

design_adr.unmet_clause: coordinating CPU/GPU/QPU — no GPU arm
design_adr.closure: ADR for accelerator backend before a Gpu substrate in compute.rs; QPU-vs-classical benchmark half already tested (hosted.rs:631, quantum_routing_central_plane.rs:92).

design_adr.unmet_clause: GPU, TPU, ... IBM QPU hardware or parallel ensembles — those substrates are always Declined (compute.rs:95-112); hardware refused by name at start (compute_routing.rs:118-124)
design_adr.closure: ADR for accelerator backends and the IBM credential/egress/budget before Gpu/Tpu/ParallelEnsemble arms in compute.rs and hosted admission in compute_routing.rs::from_lookup.

design_adr.unmet_clause: which substrate (CPU, GPU, TPU, quantum-inspired, QPU) — learning exists and is replayed (compute_routing.rs:194-212) but GPU/TPU/hardware QPU arms do not
